[ WELCOME ]

WELCOME TO
VILLA SAWAN

Villa Sawan sits on a ridge of rock above the bay, turned due west. The bedroom opens straight onto the pool, the pool runs out to the horizon, and the dining sala stands on the cliff edge where the lanterns are lit at six. Every room was placed for the same hour of the day.

[ THE HOUSE ]

A house built around one hour of the day. The rooms, the pool and the sala all face west, so the evening arrives the same way wherever you stand.
